successful_read_commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && cat yss-project.yaml && cat fixture/brief.md && cat CONTEXT.md && cat DESIGN.md'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rg --files fixture drafts docs/adr 2>/dev/null; cat fixture/data.json; cat .agents/skills/yss-prototype-stage/references/prototype-profile-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/yss-prototype-stage/references/product-design-adapter.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "test -d drafts && rg --files drafts || true; test -f scripts/vendor/yaml.mjs && head -5 scripts/vendor/yaml.mjs; rg -n 'lifecycle-document-output' .template-spec/agents/yss-skill-registry.yaml"

failed_commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'rg --files fixture drafts .template-spec/design/tokens docs/adr 2>/dev/null && cat fixture/data.json && cat .template-spec/process/document-writing.md'

scope: Tool-output byte count is not total source bytes read or token usage; multi-file and partial reads need trace inspection.
